verdict.rationale: AiPrise exposes verification APIs ("Build fully custom verification workflows using AiPrise APIs"), so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The "migration support" claim is about switching to AiPrise from another vendor, not about API lifecycle, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
